hypotheses.text: The crash test must use the dispatch moment on the database clock: extraction passes reuse one stale now, so deadline + grace can pass while a call runs. Testable: beginAttempt writes clock_timestamp() to updated_at, and a late receipt for a call dispatched under a stale now is refused while its transport is still running.
